description: GA-15 / G-27 (WP-73): the model each engine role of a run calls, for Node (domain/model-roles.ts) and Python (harness_core.access.model_roles). A run's roles are primary, fast (an engine's background and small calls), subagent (an engine's own helper) and compaction (summarising the conversation). `models.roles` maps a role key to a route (`<provider>:<model>`, split at the first colon, both parts non-empty); only the reserved keys fast, subagent and compaction name an engine role, exactly as written (a sub-agent role such as `researcher` or `default` is a child run's, MA1); a value that is not such a route is ignored. A role with no route calls the primary route. A run whose primary route is pinned to a model account (A1: a person's own key, an org cloud account) calls that route for every role, so nobody's account pays for another's model. `neutralIds`: the model id an engine names for each role; any other id is refused. `expect` maps each engine role to its route, or `primary`. Written by hand.

cases.behaviour: No roles: every role calls the primary route
An empty map is the same as none
The fast role mapped; the others call the primary route
Every engine role mapped to its own route
Sub-agent role keys (and default) are a child run's, never an engine role
Only the exact reserved key names a role
A value that is not a route is ignored
A route splits at its first colon
A primary route on a model account serves every role
